== Summary ==
Players Committee errata slip for First Officer Thaneespi, cut unchanged at 300 dpi from page 17 of the PC's ''Decipher Errata'' sheet “Official text as of March 1, 2017” (PDF made 31 May 2017): [http://www.starwarsccg.org/virtual/DErrata.pdf DErrata.pdf]. Preserved copy of the sheet: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705005900/http://www.starwarsccg.org/virtual/DErrata.pdf Internet Archive]. SHA-1 of this file: c854624b50dcc50c5036e9941a47586c2a306a77. Shown on [[First Officer Thaneespi (PC Errata 2017 slip)]].
